groups.label: Blooms
groups.blurb: The flower masses carrying the ivory-and-green palette.

items.role: Large green clusters forming the main flower mass along the top.
The white cluster accent at the top-right corner.
Fluffy round green balls dotted through the flowers.
Fine white filler clusters filling the gaps.

groups.label: Trailing strands & foliage
groups.blurb: Green line, movement and the deep base layer — the foxtail is the soul of this arch.

items.role: The long bright-green hanging tassels — the signature of this installation.
Fine feathery trailing branches adding airy movement.
Fluffy massed needle leaves forming the base layer.
Grey-green round-leaf and fine-leaf eucalyptus adding depth.
Large pinnate leaves spreading across the upper layer.
Fine winding vine branches threading through the greenery.
Deep-green needle foliage as the dark base.
